age.evidence: We used Fmr1 KO juvenile mice (P23-P25)... In adult WT mice (~2 months old)... Juvenile (P23-P25) and adult (>P60) mice were injected

sex.evidence: vehicle-treated male and female Fmr1 KO mice showed a prevalence of AGS of 72%

dosing.evidence: DPT hydrochloride... dissolved in Milli-Q (Millipore Sigma) water, which served as the vehicle... administered intraperitoneally (i.p.)... DPT (3, 5.6, 10, 15, or 20 mg/kg)
(±)-2,5-Dimethoxy-4-iodoamphetamine (DOI) at 1 mg/kg used as a positive control elicited a very high number of HTRs

group_housing.evidence: The mice were bred and raised in the vivarium at Mercer University College of Pharmacy as previously described.

day_night_flipped.evidence: All tests were performed during the light cycle (7:00-19:00).

assays.assay_description: Juvenile Fmr1 KO mice placed in a clear polycarbonate box (46 × 20 × 20 cm) and exposed to a ~105 dB alarm for 5 min; behavioral responses (normal behavior, WRJ, TCS, death) scored. Tested with DPT alone and with pretreatments by pimavanserin, WAY-100635, SB-224289, methiothepin, and NE-100.

application_type.evidence: Vehicle and all compounds for in vivo studies were administered intraperitoneally (i.p.)

setup_habituation.evidence: Juvenile mice were acclimated to the test room for 30-60 min in their home cages... Mice were placed in a clear, polycarbonate box... 1 min before being exposed to an alarm (room acclimation only, no apparatus pre-exposure).

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were placed in a clear, polycarbonate box (46 cm × 20 cm × 20 cm) covered with a perforated, clear, polycarbonate lid

food_restriction.evidence: Test apparatus is a polycarbonate box with no food present during the 5 min recording.

water_restriction.evidence: Test apparatus is a polycarbonate box with no water present during the 5 min recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: All mice were placed back in their cages and were tested 5 min after injection with DPT.

sample_size.evidence: The vehicle group includes new (N = 14) and historical (N = 53) data... cotreatment with NE-100 50 mg/kg and DPT 10 mg/kg (N = 8)

outcomes.summary: DPT 10 mg/kg completely prevented AGS (0% prevalence) in juvenile Fmr1 KO mice compared with 72% in vehicle, while lower doses (3, 5.6 mg/kg) had no effect. Pretreatment with selective 5-HT2A/2C (pimavanserin), 5-HT1A (WAY-100635), 5-HT1B (SB-224289), pan-5-HT (methiothepin) or sigma1 (NE-100) antagonists did not block DPT's antiepileptic effect.
outcomes.statistics: DPT 10 mg/kg vs vehicle p < 0.0001; 3 and 5.6 mg/kg p = 0.69; antagonist co-treatments p ≥ 0.10 (n.s.)
outcomes.evidence: DPT completely prevented AGS at 10 mg/kg (p < 0.0001)... Relative to vehicle, DPT did not significantly affect the prevalence of AGS at 3 (p = 0.69) or 5.6 mg/kg (p = 0.69).

B1_num_measures.evidence: AGS prevalence, latency to seizure onset, seizure duration, lethality, and duration of WRJ were reported.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Frequencies and total duration of seizure responses reported; no within-session time-course analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: Behavioral responses... were documented as discrete categories without formal transition/sequence analysis.

B4_ethological.evidence: Outcomes are seizure-related responses (WRJ, TCS, death), not natural ethological behaviours.

B5_social.evidence: AGS is an individual reflexive seizure assay.

B6_cognitive.evidence: AGS is a reflexive seizure model with no learning component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The frequencies of AGS were documented by visual observations of video recordings.

B8_multivariate.evidence: AGS and other behaviors were analyzed using Fisher's exact test.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Mice were placed in a clear, polycarbonate box (46 cm × 20 cm × 20 cm)

E2_shelter.evidence: Clear polycarbonate box with perforated lid; no shelter.

E3_bedding.evidence: Clear polycarbonate box; no bedding mentioned.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment items in the box.

E6_spatial.evidence: clear, polycarbonate box (46 cm × 20 cm × 20 cm)

E7_social_context.evidence: A maximum of 4 mice (2 per box) were observed simultaneously — 2 per box but during seizure recording each mouse is the focal subject; no social interaction measured.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in apparatus.

D2_session_duration.evidence: the duration of exposure was 5 min

D5_followup.evidence: tested 5 min after injection with DPT

assays.assay_description: Juvenile (P23-P25) and adult (>P60) WT mice injected i.p. with DPT (3, 5.6, 10, 15, 20 mg/kg), DOI (1 mg/kg), or vehicle and immediately placed in an open-field plexiglass chamber (43 × 43 cm, Med Associates). HTRs counted manually for 15 min; locomotor activity tracked via EthoVision; 5-HT1AR-dependent behavioral signs (flat body posture, hind limb abduction, tremors, Straub tail) also documented.

application_type.evidence: injected (i.p.) with Milli-Q water (vehicle) or DPT

setup_habituation.evidence: WT mice were acclimated to a procedure room for ≥ 30 min before administering test compounds — room acclimation only, not apparatus habituation.

setup_restrain.evidence: placed in a clear open-field plexiglass chamber (43 × 43 cm; Med Associates)

food_restriction.evidence: Open-field chamber with no food during the 15-min recording.

water_restriction.evidence: Open-field chamber with no water during the 15-min recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: injected (i.p.)... and were immediately placed in a clear open-field plexiglass chamber... counted... for 15 min postinjection

sample_size.evidence: Juvenile: F(5, 23) = 4.25; Adult: F(5, 22) = 5.18 — implies ~4-5 mice per dose group.

outcomes.summary: DPT elicited a dose-dependent HTR in juvenile and adult WT mice with a maximal effect at 10 mg/kg (the same dose effective against AGS), declining at 20 mg/kg (inverted-U). DPT did not affect locomotor activity in adult WT mice, but reduced distance traveled at 20 mg/kg in juveniles. DPT 20 mg/kg also elicited 5-HT1AR-dependent behaviors (flat body posture, hind limb abduction, tremors, Straub tail) not seen at lower doses. DOI (1 mg/kg) elicited robust HTR as a positive control.
outcomes.statistics: Juvenile HTR: F(5,23)=4.25, p=0.007; Adult HTR: F(5,22)=5.18, p=0.027; DPT vs vehicle juvenile: 3 mg/kg p=0.047, 5.6 mg/kg p=0.007, 10 mg/kg p=0.007, 15 mg/kg p=0.046, 20 mg/kg p=0.287; 5-HT1AR signs at 20 mg/kg: flat body posture/hind limb abduction/Straub tail p=0.0001, tremors p=0.003.
outcomes.evidence: DPT produced a dose-dependent head-twitch response (HTR), with maximal effects at 10 mg/kg... DPT at 20 mg/kg elicited... flat body posture, hind limb abduction, tremors, and Straub tail.

B1_num_measures.evidence: HTR count, locomotor distance, flat body posture, hind limb abduction, tremors, Straub tail.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Counts and totals over 15 min; no within-session binning reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is a stereotyped drug-induced motor response, not part of natural ethological repertoire; 5-HT1AR signs are drug-elicited motor syndromes.

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested individually in open field.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: HTRs were counted using a hand-held tally counter... Locomotor activity... calculated by EthoVision software (centroid tracking).

B8_multivariate.evidence: one-way ANOVA with Holm-Šídák's multiple comparisons test was used

E1_environment_type.evidence: clear open-field plexiglass chamber (43 × 43 cm; Med Associates)

E7_social_context.evidence: Mice were individually placed in the open-field chamber.

D5_followup.evidence: Recording within 15 min of injection only.

judge_notes: Merged GLM's separate HTR, open-field locomotor, and 5-HT1AR behavioral observation entries into a single 'Head-Twitch Response with Locomotor Activity' assay — these were all measured concurrently in the same 15-min open-field session in the same animals (only the manipulation/scored variable differed), matching the rubric's 'same apparatus/same session = one assay' rule. B1 increased to 4-6 to reflect the combined measures (HTR, locomotion, flat body posture, hind limb abduction, tremors, Straub tail).

B4 (ethological) scored 0 for HTR assay: head-twitch and 5-HT1A syndrome signs (Straub tail, flat body posture, hind-limb abduction) are drug-induced stereotyped motor responses, not behaviours from the species' natural repertoire — overriding GLM's score of 1.
B1 for AGS scored 2 (4-6 measures): paper reports AGS prevalence, latency, seizure duration, WRJ duration, and lethality (supported by Supplemental Figure S1).
setup_habituation scored 'no' rather than 'yes' for both assays: paper only describes room/procedure-room acclimation, which the rubric explicitly says does NOT count as apparatus habituation.
E7 for AGS scored Alone: although '2 per box' is mentioned, each is a focal animal with no social interaction measured and seizures are individual responses.
Excluded all in vitro pharmacology (radioligand binding, TRUPATH BRET2) per rubric — these are not behavioural assays.
